strings.auth_ldap_ad_create_req: Cannot create the new account in Active Directory. Make sure you meet all the requirements for this to work (LDAPS connection, bind user with adequate rights, etc.)
strings.auth_ldap_attrcreators: List of groups or contexts whose members are allowed to create attributes. Separate multiple groups with ';'. Usually something like 'cn=teachers,ou=staff,o=myorg'
strings.auth_ldap_bind_dn: If you want to use bind-user to search users, specify it here. Something like 'cn=ldapuser,ou=public,o=org'
strings.auth_ldap_contexts: List of contexts where users are located. Separate different contexts with ';'. For example: 'ou=users,o=org; ou=others,o=org'
strings.auth_ldap_create_context:
If you enable user creation with email confirmation, specify the context where users are created. This context should be different from other users to prevent security issues. You don't need to add this context to ldap_context-variable, Moodle will search for users from this context automatically.
Note! You have to modify the method user_create() in file auth/ldap/auth.php to make user creation work
strings.auth_ldap_expiration_desc: Select '{$a->no}' to disable expired password checking or '{$a->ldapserver}' to read the password expiry time directly from the LDAP server.
strings.auth_ldap_expiration_warning_desc: Number of days before password expiry warning is issued.
strings.auth_ldap_expireattr_desc: Optional: Overrides the LDAP attribute that stores password expiry time.
strings.auth_ldap_gracelogins_desc: Enable LDAP grace login support. After password has expired, user can log in until grace login count is 0. Enabling this setting displays grace login message if password has expired.
strings.auth_ldap_groupecreators: List of groups or contexts whose members are allowed to create groups. Separate multiple groups with ';'. Usually something like 'cn=teachers,ou=staff,o=myorg'
strings.auth_ldap_host_url: Specify LDAP host in URL-form like 'ldap://ldap.myorg.com/' or 'ldaps://ldap.myorg.com/'. Separate multiple servers with ';' to get failover support.
strings.auth_ldap_ldap_encoding: Encoding used by the LDAP server, most likely utf-8. If LDAP v2 is selected, Active Directory uses its configured encoding, such as cp1252 or cp1250.
strings.auth_ldap_memberattribute: Optional: Overrides user member attribute, when users belongs to a group. Usually 'member'
strings.auth_ldap_memberattribute_isdn: Overrides handling of member attribute values
strings.auth_ldap_no_mbstring: You need the mbstring extension to create users in Active Directory.
strings.auth_ldap_noconnect_all: LDAP-module cannot connect to any servers: {$a}
strings.auth_ldap_noextension: The PHP LDAP module does not seem to be present. Please ensure it is installed and enabled if you want to use this authentication plugin.
strings.auth_ldap_objectclass: Optional: Overrides objectClass used to name/search users on ldap_user_type. Usually you don't need to change this.
strings.auth_ldap_opt_deref: Determines how aliases are handled during search. Select one of the following values: "No" (LDAP_DEREF_NEVER) or "Yes" (LDAP_DEREF_ALWAYS)
strings.auth_ldap_passtype: Specify the format of new or changed passwords in LDAP server.
strings.auth_ldap_preventpassindb: Select yes to prevent passwords from being stored in Moodle's DB.
strings.auth_ldap_rolecontext_help: LDAP context used to select for {$a->localname} mapping. Separate multiple groups with ';'. Usually something like "cn={$a->shortname},ou=first-ou-with-role-groups,o=myorg; cn={$a->shortname},ou=second-ou-with-role-groups,o=myorg".
strings.auth_ldap_suspended_attribute: Optional: When provided this attribute will be used to enable/suspend the locally created user account.
strings.auth_ldap_unsupportedusertype: auth: ldap user_create() does not support selected usertype: {$a}
strings.auth_ldap_update_userinfo: Update user information (firstname, lastname, address..) from LDAP to Moodle.  Specify "Data mapping" settings as you need.
strings.auth_ldap_user_attribute: Optional: Overrides the attribute used to name/search users. Usually 'cn'.
strings.auth_ldap_user_type: Select how users are stored in LDAP. This setting also specifies how login expiry, grace logins and user creation will work.
strings.auth_ldap_usertypeundefined: config.user_type not defined or function ldap_expirationtime2unix does not support selected type!
strings.auth_ldap_usertypeundefined2: config.user_type not defined or function ldap_unixi2expirationtime does not support selected type!
strings.auth_ldap_version: The version of the LDAP protocol your server is using.
strings.auth_ldapdescription: This method provides authentication against an external LDAP server. If the given username and password are valid, Moodle creates a new user entry in its database. This plugin can read user attributes from LDAP and prefill wanted fields in Moodle. For following logins only the username and password are checked.
strings.auth_ldapextrafields:
These fields are optional. You can choose to pre-fill some Moodle user fields with information from the LDAP fields that you specify here.

If you leave these fields blank, then nothing will be transferred from LDAP and Moodle defaults will be used instead.

In either case, the user will be able to edit all of these fields after they log in.
strings.auth_ldapnotinstalled: Cannot use LDAP authentication. The PHP LDAP module is not installed.
strings.auth_ntlmsso_enabled: Set to yes to attempt Single Sign On with the NTLM domain. Note that this requires additional setup on the server to work. For further details, see the documentation NTLM authentication.
strings.auth_ntlmsso_ie_fastpath: Set to enable the NTLM SSO fast path (bypasses certain steps if the client's browser is MS Internet Explorer).
strings.auth_ntlmsso_ie_fastpath_yesform: Yes, all other browsers use standard login form
strings.auth_ntlmsso_maybeinvalidformat: Unable to extract the username from the REMOTE_USER header. Is the configured format right?
strings.auth_ntlmsso_missing_username: You need to specify at least %username% in the remote username format
strings.auth_ntlmsso_remoteuserformat:
If you have chosen 'NTLM' in 'Authentication type', you can specify the remote username format here. If you leave this empty, the default DOMAIN\username format will be used. You can use the optional %domain% placeholder to specify where the domain name appears, and the mandatory %username% placeholder to specify where the username appears.

Some widely used formats are %domain%\%username% (MS Windows default), %domain%/%username%, %domain%+%username% and just %username% (if there is no domain part).
strings.auth_ntlmsso_subnet: If set, it will only attempt SSO with clients in this subnet. Format: xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx/bitmask. Separate multiple subnets with ',' (comma).
strings.auth_ntlmsso_type: The authentication method configured in the web server to authenticate the users (if in doubt, choose NTLM)
strings.cannotmaprole: The role "{$a->rolename}" cannot be mapped because its short name "{$a->shortname}" is too long and/or contains hyphens. To allow it to be mapped, the short name needs to be reduced to a maximum of {$a->charlimit} characters and any hyphens removed. Edit the role
strings.connectingldapsuccess: Connecting to your LDAP server was successful
strings.diag_contextnotfound: Context {$a} doesn't exist or can't be read by bind DN.
strings.diag_rolegroupnotfound: Group {$a->group} for role {$a->localname} doesn't exist or can't be read by bind DN.
strings.diag_toooldversion: It is very unlikely a modern LDAP server uses LDAPv2 protocol. Wrong settings can corrupt values in user fields. Check with your LDAP administrator.
strings.didntgetusersfromldap: Did not get any users from LDAP -- error? -- exiting
strings.invalidusererrors: Warning: Skipped creation of {$a} user accounts.
strings.ldapnotconfigured: The LDAP host url is currently not configured
strings.morethanoneuser: More than one user record found in LDAP. Using only the first one.
strings.needbcmath: You need the BCMath extension to use expired password checking with Active Directory.
strings.needmbstring: You need the mbstring extension to change passwords in Active Directory
strings.nodnforusername: Error in user_update_password(). No DN for: {$a->username}
strings.noemail: Tried to send you an email but failed!
strings.notcalledfromserver: Should not be called from the web server!
strings.nouserentriestoremove: No user entries to be removed
strings.nouserentriestorevive: No user entries to be revived
strings.nouserstobeadded: No user entries to be added
strings.ntlmsso_attempting: Attempting Single Sign On via NTLM...
strings.ntlmsso_failed: Auto-login failed, try the normal login page...
strings.pagedresultsnotsupp: LDAP paged results not supported (either your PHP version lacks support, you have configured Moodle to use LDAP protocol version 2 or Moodle cannot contact your LDAP server to see if paged support is available.)
strings.pagesize: Make sure this value is smaller than your LDAP server result set size limit (the maximum number of entries that can be returned in a single query)
strings.privacy:metadata: The LDAP server authentication plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.renamingnotallowed: User renaming not allowed in LDAP
strings.rootdseerror: Error querying rootDSE for Active Directory
strings.start_tls: Use regular LDAP service (port 389) with TLS encryption
strings.sync_updateuserchunk: Set this value to the number of users you want updated per transaction. Setting this to 0 will update all users in one transaction.
strings.updatepasserror: Error in user_update_password(). Error code: {$a->errno}; Error string: {$a->errstring}
strings.updatepasserrorexpire: Error in user_update_password() when reading password expiry time. Error code: {$a->errno}; Error string: {$a->errstring}
strings.updatepasserrorexpiregrace: Error in user_update_password() when modifying expiry time and/or grace logins. Error code: {$a->errno}; Error string: {$a->errstring}
strings.updateremfail:
Error updating LDAP record. Error code: {$a->errno}; Error string: {$a->errstring}
Key ({$a->key}) - old moodle value: '{$a->ouvalue}' new value: '{$a->nuvalue}'
strings.updateremfailamb: Failed to update LDAP with ambiguous field {$a->key}; old moodle value: '{$a->ouvalue}', new value: '{$a->nuvalue}'
strings.updateusernotfound: Could not find user while updating externally. Details follow: search base: '{$a->userdn}'; search filter: '(objectClass=*)'; search attributes: {$a->attribs}
strings.user_activatenotsupportusertype: auth: ldap user_activate() does not support selected usertype: {$a}
strings.user_disablenotsupportusertype: auth: ldap user_disable() does not support selected usertype: {$a}
